listing.name: Call of Duty: Black Ops (Xbox 360) — Call of Duty Black Ops (BO1) — static recompilation for PC (LucioXerus)
listing.summary: Campaign starts with cinematics; full playthrough still being verified. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Call of Duty: Black Ops (Xbox 360) Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. Mandatory TU 11; both default/default_mp XEX and XEXP plus patched data.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build SDK, bootstrap TU 11-patched XEX dumps, generate both Black Ops programs and compile locally from own files.
